# PowerMonitor.NfClient

## nanoFramework CLR build

[Firmware](Resources/nanoCLR_C3_Onewire_8a962819c18815db3f7e4c55be697b8e1d65cdd5.bin) built from nf-interpreter commit #8a962819c18815db3f7e4c55be697b8e1d65cdd5

    # defconfig for ESP32_C3_REV3
    # Auto-generated by preset_to_defconfig.py
    CONFIG_API_HARDWARE_ESP32=y
    # CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_ADC=y
    # CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_DAC is not set
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_GPIO=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_I2C=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_I2C_SLAVE=y
    # CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_I2S=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_PWM=y
    # CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_SPI=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_DEVICE_WIFI=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_IO_FILESYSTEM=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_IO_PORTS=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_MATH=y
    CONFIG_API_SYSTEM_NET=y
    # CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_ESPNOW=y
    # CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_DEVICE_BLUETOOTH=y
    
    # Enabling OneWire for the ESP32-C3 results in a compile error identifier "UART_NUM_2" is undefined.
    # Tell AI agent to enable this for the ESP32-C3.
    CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_DEVICE_ONEWIRE=y

    CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_HARDWARE_ESP32_RMT=y
    # CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_RESOURCEMANAGER=y
    CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_SYSTEM_COLLECTIONS=y
    CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_SYSTEM_IO_HASHING=y
    CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_SYSTEM_SECURITY_CRYPTOGRAPHY=y
    CONFIG_API_NANOFRAMEWORK_SYSTEM_TEXT=y
    CONFIG_NF_WP_TRANSPORT_USB_CDC_OR_SERIAL=y
    # CONFIG_NF_BUILD_RTM is not set
    CONFIG_NF_FEATURE_DEBUGGER=y
    CONFIG_NF_FEATURE_HAS_ACCESSIBLE_STORAGE=y
    CONFIG_NF_FEATURE_HAS_CONFIG_BLOCK=y
    # CONFIG_NF_FEATURE_HAS_SDCARD is not set
    CONFIG_NF_FEATURE_RTC=y
    CONFIG_NF_FEATURE_USE_LITTLEFS=y
    # CONFIG_NF_CLR_NO_TRACE is not set
    # CONFIG_NF_TARGET_HAS_NANOBOOTER is not set
    CONFIG_RTOS_ESP32=y
    CONFIG_SDK_CONFIG_FILE="sdkconfig.default_rev3.esp32c3"
    CONFIG_NF_SUPPORT_ANY_BASE_CONVERSION=y
    CONFIG_TARGET_BOARD="ESP32_C3"
    CONFIG_TARGET_SERIES="ESP32_C3"


Visual studio [nanoFramework.Tools.VS2022.Extension 2022.14.2.37](Resources/nanoFramework.Tools.VS2022.Extension_2022.14.2.37.vsix)
